name: required extra column
to: required_value TEXT NOT NULL, display_name TEXT NOT NULL

name: on update action
from: principal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id)
to: principal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE

name: on delete action
from: principal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id)
to: principal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

name: deferred foreign key
from: principal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id)
to: principal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

name: primary key conflict action
to: id TEXT PRIMARY KEY ON CONFLICT REPLACE, kind

name: identity collation
to: id TEXT COLLATE NOCASE PRIMARY KEY, kind

name: additional write trigger
sql: CREATE TRIGGER deny_principal BEFORE INSERT ON principals BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'synthetic refusal'); END;

name: malformed upgrade-created deliveries
sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS subagent_dispatch_deliveries(claim_id TEXT, kind TEXT, conversation_id TEXT, recipient_membership_id TEXT, state TEXT, terminal_state TEXT, payload TEXT, attempt_count INTEGER, created_at INTEGER, updated_at INTEGER, delivered_at INTEGER, admitted_turn_id TEXT);
